figures.quote: MEC reported Adjusted EBITDA of $6.3 million in the fourth quarter of 2025, or 4.7% of net sales, versus $9.2 million, or 7.6% of net sales, in the prior year period.
MEC reported Adjusted EBITDA of $6.3 million in the fourth quarter of 2025, or 4.7% of net sales, versus $9.2 million, or 7.6% of net sales, in the prior year period.

parsed.notes: The excerpt does not include the reconciliation table, so these figures come from the release text. FY2025 Adjusted EBITDA of $47.1 million also appears as the 'FY 2025 Actual' in the guidance table. No full-year 2024 Adjusted EBITDA is shown. The guidance table also shows a Q1 2025 actual Adjusted EBITDA of $12.2 million (in millions); it is not listed above because it is neither the reported quarter, its prior-year comparison, nor a year-to-date total. The 2026 guidance ranges are forecasts and are excluded.
